mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account_access_tokens (id, account_id, name, token_hash, token_prefix, created_at, expires_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{accountId}, #{name}, #{tokenHash}, #{tokenPrefix}, #{createdAt}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM account_access_tokens WHERE account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id
mapper.update: UPDATE account_access_tokens SET revoked_at = COALESCE(revoked_at, #{now}) WHERE id = #{id} AND account_id = #{accountId}
UPDATE account_access_tokens SET last_used_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND revoked_at IS NULL AND expires_at > #{now}
